bio.text: Alyse Galvin has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 14 since 2023.

According to Galvin's legislative biography, the representative holds a B.A. in political science from the University of California, San Diego, and lists Anchorage and, from 1999 to 2002, Juneau among the Alaska communities lived in.

Galvin's listed work includes serving as a partnership liaison at the Alaska Department of Education, owning Galvin Education Consulting, and co-founding the education-funding advocacy group Great Alaska Schools.
